author: Top Gear
description:
In this video Top Gear reviews the new McLaren W1. With 3(!) McLaren W1s to pick from and the entire Circuito de Navarra to play with, the 1275hp hypercar is put to the test to see if it’s both a worthy successor to the McLaren F1 and P1, and to find out whether it’s game over for its arch-rival, the Ferrari F80.
